mapper.select: SELECT linked_account_id, user_id AS userId, account_id AS accountId, account_number AS accountNumber, bank_code AS bankCode, account_holder_name AS accountHolderName, connection_status AS connectionStatus, balance AS balance, created_at AS createdAt FROM linked_bank_account WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT linked_account_id, user_id AS userId, account_id AS accountId, account_number AS accountNumber, bank_code AS bankCode, account_holder_name AS accountHolderName, connection_status AS connectionStatus, balance AS balance, created_at AS createdAt FROM linked_bank_account WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND connection_status = 'AVAILABLE'
